title: Vanishing of the left base-change term (Stacks Tag 00S2)
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $H_1(L_{B/A})=0$ and projective $\Omega_{B/A}$, where these notions are those of [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Let $C=B/\mathfrak a$ for an ideal $\mathfrak a\subseteq B$. If $\operatorname{Tor}_1^B(\Omega_{B/A},C)=\operatorname{Tor}_2^B(\Omega_{B/A},C)=0$ (the Tor criterion in [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-homology-sequence]), then **Stacks Tag 00S2 (lemma-exact-sequence-NL)** identifies $$H_1(\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}\otimes_B C)\cong H_1(L_{B/A})\otimes_B C=0.$$ In particular the Tor hypotheses hold when $\Omega_{B/A}$ is projective, since projective modules are flat.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00S2, final assertion and proof, lines 35444--35446 and 35467--35485; More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M7
